message.content: I’ve narrowed this to the option dispatcher and `sort_key` setter, plus `header_style` calling its validator directly. I’ll correct these, then use the full test suite and the saved reproduction to check behavior before and after the fix.

function.name: bash
function.arguments:
{"command":"cd /testbed && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('src/prettytable/prettytable.py')
text = path.read_text()
old = '''        if option == "field_names":
            self._validate_none_format(val)
        elif option == "none_format":
            self._validate_field_names(val)
'''
new = '''        if option == "field_names":
            self._validate_field_names(val)
        elif option == "none_format":
            self._validate_none_format(val)
'''
assert old in text
text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
text = text.replace('''            self._validate_nonnegative_int(option, val - 1)
''', '''            self._validate_nonnegative_int(option, val)
''', 1)
text = text.replace('''            self._validate_field_name(val, option)
''', '''            self._validate_field_name(option, val)
''', 1)
text = text.replace('''            self._validate_function(f"{option}_key", val)
''', '''            self._validate_function(option, val)
''', 1)
text = text.replace('''            self._validate_true_or_false(val, option)
''', '''            self._validate_true_or_false(option, val)
''', 1)
text = text.replace('''            self._validate_header_style(option)
''', '''            self._validate_header_style(val)
''', 1)
text = text.replace('''        elif option == "float_format":
            pass
''', '''        elif option == "float_format":
            self._validate_float_format(option, val)
''', 1)
text = text.replace('''            self._validate_attributes(val, option)
''', '''            self._validate_attributes(option, val)
''', 1)
text = text.replace('''        self._validate_option("sort_key", self._sort_key)
        self._sort_key = None
''', '''        self._validate_option("sort_key", val)
        self._sort_key = val
''', 1)
path.write_text(text)

# Correct the assertion in the none-format validator to reject non-string values.
text = path.read_text()
old = '''                if isinstance(val, str):
                    pass
'''
new = '''                assert isinstance(val, str)
'''
assert old in text
text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
path.write_text(text)
PY
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('tests/test_prettytable.py')
text = path.read_text()
anchor = '''def test_version() -> None:
'''
tests = '''def test_option_validation_uses_values_and_validator_arguments() -> None:
    table = PrettyTable()
    table.field_names = ["Name", "Age", "City"]
    table.add_row(["Alice", 25, "New York"])

    table.none_format = "N/A"
    table.sortby = "Name"
    table.header = True
    table.border = False
    table.padding_width = 0
    table.left_padding_width = 0
    table.right_padding_width = 0
    table.attributes = {"class": "prettytable"}
    table.header_style = "upper"
    table.sort_key = lambda row: row

    assert table.sort_key(["Alice", 25, "New York"]) == ["Alice", 25, "New York"]
    assert table.get_string().count("Alice") == 1
    assert "N/A" in table.get_string()

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid value for header"):
        table.header = "yes"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid field name: Missing"):
        table.sortby = "Missing"
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="Replacement for None value"):
        table.none_format = 1
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid value for float_format"):
        table.float_format = "invalid"


def test_option_validation_in_constructor_and_get_string() -> None:
    table = PrettyTable(
        ["Name", "Age"],
        header=True,
        sortby="Name",
        padding_width=0,
        left_padding_width=0,
        right_padding_width=0,
        attributes={"class": "prettytable"},
        header_style="upper",
        float_format=".2f",
    )
    table.add_row(["Alice", 25])

    assert "ALICE" in table.get_string(header=True, sortby="Name", padding_width=0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid field name: Missing"):
        table.get_string(sortby="Missing")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid header style"):
        PrettyTable(["Name"], header_style="invalid")


'''
assert anchor in text
text = text.replace(anchor, tests + anchor, 1)
path.write_text(text)
PY
python -m pytest -q --tb=short > /tmp/prettytable-fixed-tests.txt 2>&1; result=$?; tail -50 /tmp/prettytable-fixed-tests.txt; exit "$result""}
